notes.zh: 安装前检测共享 .NET 8 和 WinUI 3；缺少时明确列出并再次征求同意后下载，已有兼容组件直接复用。升级时按已核验的历史文件指纹清理旧内置运行库，保留配置、邮件报告及用户文件，不卸载系统共享组件。卸载从确认到完成保持同一个窗口，不再关闭后重新打开。
notes.en: Detects shared .NET 8 and WinUI 3 before installation; missing components are downloaded only after explicit confirmation, while compatible installed components are reused. Upgrades remove verified obsolete bundled runtime files while preserving configuration, reports and user files; system shared runtimes remain installed. Uninstallation keeps one continuous window from confirmation to completion.

notes.zh: 登录用户名默认留空并移入高级连接选项，默认认证跟随邮箱地址，自定义用户名仍可保留。下载更新时并行进行小流量测速，在Mac更新服务和GitHub之间选择较快可用来源；网络失败或下载中断时换源重试，SHA256不符则停止安装。
notes.en: Leaves the optional login username blank inside advanced connection settings; default authentication follows the email address while custom usernames are preserved. Bounded concurrent probes compare the Mac update service and GitHub, then download from a faster usable source. Network failures and incomplete streams retry another source; SHA256 mismatches block installation.
